sources.details: For N=30 pairs with each side L effective answer/EOS targets, total exposure is N*(L_chosen+L_rejected): 30*(100+100)=6000 and 30*(10+10)=600. Counts are not a gradient magnitude guarantee. One scalar shared across all prompts has logits [theta,0], preferred refusal; at theta=0, beta=.1 its DPO gradient is -.05, one learning-rate .1 step makes theta=.005, so greedy decoding can refuse all prompts even absent benign training examples.
